manual.reason: The desktop conversation host is a large visual change that the user has asked to confirm on a real screen before it is merged; no automated test can stand in for that confirmation.
manual.steps: Start an isolated instance, open a friend, a group and a device conversation on desktop in light and dark themes at 1280, 1440 and 1920 widths, switch between them and the Agent, then repeat the mobile conversation flows at 390 width.
manual.expected: Each conversation fills the main chat area with the header and flipped avatar described by FCC-SCN-009, drafts and positions per FCC-SCN-010, no overlap or overflow, and mobile navigation unchanged; the user records approval before any merge.
